profile.headline: Software Engineer at XP Health
profile.summary:
Front End: | JavaScript (ES5 and ES6), React, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Bootstrap, Redux, NextJS
Back End: | Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, RESTful API Development, Nginx, 
Testing/Deployment: | Jest, Mocha, Chai, AWS (Certified SA) , React Testing Library, Loader.io, K6, ESLint, Kubernetes,
Developer Tools: | Vim, Git, npm, Webpack, Babel, Agile Methodology, Scrum, TDD, Streams API
Agile Frameworks: | Trello, Jira/Confluence

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
-Atelier Microservice |  https://github.com/Watchful-Walnut/reviews-api			                   2022 
Built a multi-layer backend reviews service on AWS t2.micros with initial capacity of 500 rps which was then optimized to handle 1,500 rps with baseline response time, a throughput increase of 300%. 
One-click scalable, self healing architecture using Kubernetes and Docker.
Built out an ETL program leveraging Node.js streams to transform and load 10 million data points.


-Visual Regression Tester | https://github.com/ericjlie/Visual-Regression-Tester			     2022  
Visual Regression Test Interface
Webcrawler and BackstopJS powered web interface for performing visual regression testing on websites.


-Project Oak | https://github.com/Omniscient-Oak/FEC-CATWALK					     2022  
Web commerce platform
Improved initial page load payload from 2.5mb to 300kb using lazy-loading and static and dynamic compression.
Designed and implemented website components to drive traffic to a variety of related products.
